title: Large language model-based biological age prediction in large-scale populations

evidence_spans.quote: identify proteomic biomarkers associated with accelerated aging

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This original report analyzes population health data and biological aging. It reports proteomic biomarkers, but the epigenetic ages are comparators and no completed multi-omics analysis or two current molecular modalities are described.

causal_design_reviewer.comparator: Other aging proxies, including telomere length, frailty index, epigenetic ages, and machine-learning model predictions
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: C-index of 0.757 for all-cause mortality; hazard ratio of 1.055 for the overall age gap and all-cause mortality

evidence_spans.quote: Our results showed that the LLM-predicted overall age achieved a concordance index
we propose a framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to estimate individual overall and organ-specific aging

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents completed validation and prediction results, but describes predictive modeling and associations rather than an applied qualifying design.

directional_result_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract reports predictive performance and associations, without a matching current-report directional result assertion.
